issues.description: The problem statement requires a variable `global_count` defined as a 32-bit integer, but the solution repository defines `global_count` with the directive `db` (define byte), which allocates an 8-bit value. This is a type/size mismatch: students following the problem will expect a 32-bit (doubleword) definition (e.g., `dd` in NASM). Presenting `db` in the solution contradicts the specification and may confuse students about the required storage size or lead to incorrect behavior when the variable is used as a 32-bit value.
issues.suggested_fix: In the solution (and/or template if you wish to provide a starter), define `global_count` as a 32-bit value using the correct NASM directive. For example: `global_count dd 0` (replace `db` with `dd`) and update any accompanying comment to state it's a 32-bit integer.
